notes: Replayed on 2024-26, 2,469 games: picked the winner 67% of the time, the closing line 69%. The market was the better forecast.
Replayed on 2024-26: right against the closing spread 49% of the time. No edge on the line.
Priced from the same margin as the spread; alternate lines were not replayed on their own.

Simulated from each player's minutes and per-minute rates, with who plays drawn in every simulation, and priced against DraftKings' own line and price. Replayed on the 2024-26 seasons (about 45,000 player-games, nobody told who plays) the chances came out within about a point, once points, which ran three light, were nudged up. ESPN only carries props for games not yet played, so each line is saved before tip-off and graded afterwards; the NBA page's Record tab has the running comparison with DraftKings.
